n343d407fe1.summary: Declining cargo volumes at Latvian ports since 2019 have caused a loss of €1.7 billion in value-added products. Political disputes are also stalling reforms, according to the report.

n7fd23fca42.headline: UK Government bond sell-off eases after Budget date confirmed
n7fd23fca42.summary: The sell-off in UK government bonds, known as gilts, has eased after the Budget date was confirmed. Markets had focused heavily on the Budget amid worries over Britain's public finances.

n9b09c20664.summary: An IMF team has arrived in Kyiv to discuss Ukraine's 2026 budget plans, its medium-term fiscal framework, and monetary and exchange rate policies with authorities.
n9b09c20664.why: The IMF is the main multilateral lender and policy monitor for Ukraine, so its programme reviews shape financing access and investor confidence in the country.
